name: Kouhei Ishida
source:
Kouhei seems to look so quiet but he's not. He is the president of his school's geometry club, an active member of tennis club and a consistent honor student.
Many student thinks that he is unapproachable because of his status in school. However, Eimi managed to get to know him and discover his human side. But is that enough reason for him to love Eimi more than friends?
